name: x.md
description: Reads public X posts, threads, profiles, connections, and search results as Markdown or JSON. x.md does not speak the A2A task protocol: call it as an MCP server at the url below, or over plain HTTP using https://x.pcstyle.dev/openapi.json. Read-only, and no credentials are required.

skills.name: Read an X post or thread
skills.description: Read one public X post with its thread and conversation context. MCP tool x_md_get_post, or GET /{handle}/status/{id}.
examples: Summarize the thread at this x.com status link.

skills.name: Read an X profile
skills.description: Read a public X profile and its latest original posts. MCP tool x_md_get_profile, or GET /{handle}.
examples: Who is @vercel and what have they posted lately?

skills.name: Search public X posts and accounts
skills.description: Search public X posts or accounts, including X advanced-search operators. MCP tool x_md_search_posts, or GET /search?q=.
examples: Find recent posts from:vercel about deployments.

skills.name: List followers and following
skills.description: List who a public X account follows, or who follows it. MCP tools x_md_get_followers and x_md_get_following, or GET /{handle}/followers and /{handle}/following.
